test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

PRIMARY
solution: The correct answer is '**Secondary**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Primary**' is '**Secondary**'. • **Primary**: most important; main. (सबसे बड़ा; मुख्‍य, प्रधान) • *Example: Smoking is one of the **primary** causes of lung cancer.* • **Secondary**: less important than something else. [(दूसरे की अपेक्षा) गौण] • *Example: Other people’s opinions are **secondary**—it’s my opinion that counts.* **Correct Answer:__** *Secondary.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Effective**: successfully producing the result that you want. (अभीष्‍ट प्रभाव उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला; प्रभावोत्‍पादक) • **Applicable**: that concerns somebody/something; relevant to somebody/something. (संबंधित; उपयुक्त) • **Active**: involved in activity; lively. (सक्रिय, क्रियाशील; चुस्‍त, फुरतीला, जीवंत) 19a:T747, The correct answer is **'against'.**
